answer: The warrant costs 2 years of work and 4000 cabinet audits per name — cheap once, ruinous at farm scale. Entry needs the lagoon, honesty needs the opal, and the future needs the plume it can still read. You cannot borrow Urbane inlayman warrant with inlaymen attestation from a neighbour; a warrant inlaymen renew after cabinet audits. Copies cannot carry that weight.
